raw: {"triples":[{"subject":"Natural Language Processing","predicate":"uses","object":"high-dimensional vector space","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"In Natural Language Processing (NLP) all the recent and fundamental studies on word and sentence embeddings , e.g. (Mikolov et al., 2013; Pen- nington et al., 2014; Bojanowski et al., 2016; Le and Mikolov, 2014; Sutskever et al., 2014; Kiros et al., 2015; Subramanian et al., 2018; Cer et al., 2018), as well as the older works on word spaces based on co-occurence measures, e.g. see the re- views from , rely on an high-dimensional vec- tor space to represent concepts, through the appli- cation of the Harrisian distributional hypothesis, collecting contextual information from text cor- pora, and measuring their relationships by means nitive psychology (Busemeyer, 2012; Haven and Khrennikov, 2013; Pothos and Busemeyer, 2013; Yearsley et al., 2015; Wendt, 2015; Ashtiani and Azgomi, 2015; Aerts et al., 2016a,b; Haven and Khrennikov, 2018)."}]

{"triples":[{"subject":"Deep Neural Network","predicate":"trainedOn","object":"problem output classes","object_type":"Dataset","source_sentence":"There are some recent work in literature proposing techniques for computing complex-valued sentence embeddings to solve a specific task by training a Deep Neural Network (DNN) on the problem output classes."},{"subject":"word2vec","predicate":"produces","object":"complex word embeddings","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"We took inspiration from the unpublished undocumented code made available by Th´eo Trouillon extending word2vec code for working on complex numbers and generating complex word embeddings."}]}

{"triples":[{"subject":"Paragraph Vectors","predicate":"produces","object":"complex paragraph vectors","object_type":"Other","source_sentence":"Following their paper and the suggestions given by T. Mikolov for implementing PVs4, we extended the code accordingly, producing complex paragraph vectors (cPVs) for fragments of texts longer than a word."}]}

{"triples":[{"subject":"training","predicate":"achieves","object":"reliable dense vector representations for the paragraph in the complex domain","object_type":"Concept","source_sentence":"As in the cited paper, it was sufficient to insert a fake word at the beginning of the paragraph and training it together with all the other words forming the paragraph to obtain , at the end of the training process, reliable dense vector representations for the paragraph in the complex domain as well as complex vector representations for words (cWV)."},{"subject":"WSD","predicate":"uses","object":"vector representations","object_type":"Concept","source_sentence":"Although this vectors are not derived using QPT and we used the Dirac notation only for consistency, they will enable us to use such complex vectors as the basic elements in our WSD algorithm based on QPT."}]}
